[[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]] }} '''Ampharos Amore''' (Japanese: '''VS デンリュウ''' ''VS {{tt|Denryu|Ampharos}}''), titled '''VS Ampharos''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 109th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 19th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Inside the [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]], [[Jasmine]] tells [[Amphy]] to shine a light. Outside, Amphy's light is seen by {{adv|Gold}} who then hurries towards the tower. Back inside the tower, Jasmine finds {{adv|Silver}} standing over her. When Gold runs into the room, Silver is carrying the unconscious Jasmine. Silver tells Gold that he's going to help Jasmine, but Gold doesn't believe it so Silver puts Jasmine in Gold's arms. Gold looks at the statue of {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}}, then runs off to the exit. Suddenly boulders and pieces of wood fall towards Gold, but Silver's {{p|Ursaring}} pushes the landslide back. Ursaring then uses {{m|Fury Swipes}} on the wall, which causes it to break. Amphy runs out carrying Jasmine, however the exit is suddenly covered by rocks. Silver returns {{p|Ursaring}} to its [[Heavy Ball]]. [[Exbo]] ignites its fire, and Gold thanks it for the light. Silver yells at Gold because fire eats up oxygen, therefore Exbo's flame is put out. Then a landslide rushes forward, so Gold has Exbo use {{m|Flame Wheel}} on the ceiling. This does not work, and the former land gives everyone a small space between the mud and the ceiling. Silver tells Gold to send out his {{type|Water}} Pokémon, because water will pull up underground water, which will let them escape. Gold sends out [[Polibo]], who is holding the [[King's Rock]] and Silver sends out his {{TP|Silver|Croconaw}}. Silver says that the maximum amount of water that Polibo can use is too small, but then Polibo evolves into {{p|Poliwhirl}}. Silver tells Gold to trade using the [[Pokédex]]. Gold does so as the tower is completely filled with mud. Then, water shoots out of the tower, along with Silver, Gold, Croconaw, and Gold's evolved {{p|Politoed}}. After escaping the Tin Tower, Silver realizes that the earthquake was caused by a trained [[Pokémon]]. Silver also thinks about the ice in the Tin Tower. ==Major events== * [[Jasmine]] and [[Amphy]] are stuck inside the [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]] after an earthquake in [[Ecruteak City]]. * {{adv|Silver}} helps Jasmine from the rubble after being trapped. * {{adv|Gold}} and Silver are trapped inside the Tin Tower as it starts to sink into the ground. * Gold's {{p|Poliwag}}, [[Polibo]], evolves into {{p|Poliwhirl}}. * Gold trades Polibo to Silver, which causes him to evolve into {{p|Politoed}}. * Gold and Silver escape, but are surrounded by {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Ampharos}} * {{p|Politoed}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * [[Jasmine]] * {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s (silhouette) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poliwag}} ([[Polibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s; evolves) * {{p|Poliwhirl}} ([[Polibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s; newly evolved; evolves) * {{p|Politoed}} ([[Polibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s; newly evolved) * {{p|Quilava}} ([[Exbo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Croconaw}} ({{OP|Silver|Croconaw}}) * {{p|Ursaring}} ({{OP|Silver|Ursaring}}) * {{p|Ampharos}} ([[Amphy]]; [[Jasmine]]'s) * {{p|Poliwrath}} (fantasy) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}; statue) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, [[Amphy]] is called by its Japanese nickname, Akari. * In one panel [[Polibo]], as a {{p|Poliwhirl}}, is missing his King's Rock. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 電龍|VS Ampharos}} (Taiwan)
